name: 予定工数と実績計測の表
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
Render ONE static Japanese Lighthouse time-fields table LH09-0037. Originals1–2 control all icon silhouettes, fine stroke, optical sizes, grid proportions, spacing and visible empty-input state. Mock3 gives Japanese wording only; restore original distinct clock/stopwatch and circular play icon instead of rough duplicate-clock/triangle substitutes.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas, compact666x82 logical pixels. Left label「項目」at x22, top20px, Meiryo Regular12/16 black. To right at x144, y4, a WHITE rounded table500x72px, fine neutral1px border, radius5px, no gray fill or heavy shadow. Two36px rows; first column200px, second300px. Thin horizontal row divider and vertical cell divider, no additional column divider.
Row1 left cell: original tiny CLOCK outline with two hands +「予定工数」. Right cell: empty-input action「予定工数を追加」.
Row2 left cell: original tiny STOPWATCH with distinct top button/knob +「実績工数」. NOT the same clock as row1. Right cell: empty-input action「実績を追加」and then original CIRCULAR outlined PLAY button (thin triangle enclosed inside thin circle) +「計測を開始」, inline with source spacing. Do not turn play into a bare triangle or huge filled button.
All Japanese cell text Meiryo Regular12/16, zero tracking, slate #667078; no bold. Supporting clock/stopwatch #526173,12px optical size, fine original strokes. Play action can use brand green #1F6444 while preserving exact circular enclosure and geometry. Keep alignment and compact padding12px. No actual time values or running timer state, no extra labels/headers/rows, no broad mint/gray panels, app shell, watermark, perspective, annotation or comparison board. Crisp flat UI, tight framing.
reviewNotes: 日本語2行と円内再生ボタンを確認。時計の線が原本より重く、ストップウォッチに余分な側部ノブ、再生三角が塗りのため訂正。元の細線と中抜き形状を優先。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.acquisitionRoute: Chromeで観察した公開画像URLまたは文書化された画像保存
